data.narrative:
Pila Energy is a seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Cole Ashman that has raised $4M to date. The climate and energy sector contains 8 private peers and 1 public comparable (LNZA), though no private peers share Pila's exact stage or valuation tier in sufficient quantity to support reliable peer median analysis.

Given data constraints, the valuation rests on stage-progression methodology. Using total raised ($4M) as a baseline valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $10M. This reflects the expected value creation milestone between seed completion and Series A entry.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $8M to $12M, centered at $10M. However, this conclusion depends entirely on one method and carries meaningful uncertainty. The absence of same-stage or adjacent-stage comparable data points limits confidence in the step-up multiplier applied. Key sensitivities include: actual burn rate and runway extension relative to milestone achievement, capital efficiency versus peer benchmarks (where data exist), and sector-level financing conditions for climate tech. A narrower range would require additional seed-stage or pre-Series A transaction comps within climate and energy, or directional guidance on business metrics and cash runway.
